purpose: Supplementary fixed-budget comparison; not baseline reselection, external SOTA, hyperparameter search or a replacement for the matched three-seed component experiment.
selection_rule: Freeze available complete lightweight implementations representing v5u/v8/v11 and a P2 configuration; no selection based on new test scores. All four retained irrespective of rank.

models.label: YOLOv5nu
models.role: Ultralytics YOLOv5u nano; C3 backbone and anchor-free Detect head, not original anchor-based YOLOv5n.

models.label: YOLO11n-P2
models.role: Existing Y-T-G community P2 configuration; base architecture underlying the complete A reference, without MSDA modules.

initialization: Scratch, no pretrained weights; native upstream initialization retained.
checkpoint: Terminal epoch50 full-precision EMA; no validation model selection or early stopping.
evaluation: Original frozen evaluate_sirst_protocol.py; grouped test389, two classes retained, FP32, input640, confidence.001, highest-class selection, NMS.7, maxDets300, no TTA.
reported_metric: UAV/all/AP50:95, percentage; all six models seed17. Full evaluator outputs retained for audit only.
evaluation_freeze: Complete all four trainings and freeze terminal checkpoint hashes before new final-set inference. Historical A/H results are already known; no claim this comparison was planned before viewing those results.
smoke: 64 frozen training images only, 2 epochs under a 50-epoch schedule; checks finite gradients, exact loader matching and state reload; not used to select methods or hyperparameters.
scope: Single-seed fixed-budget comparison, no uncertainty or significance estimate, no best-performance/convergence claim.
software: Installed Ultralytics8.3.161; official v5u/v8/v11 definitions copied unchanged, scale n and nc2 set at construction; community P2 copied unchanged.
